Ivy Park: Quick note 3: scheduling a short maintenance for az5 GPU pool (az5-gpu-core ~40 GPUs) next Mon 00:15-01:30 UTC. Purpose: NIC microcode + small kernel livepatch.
Diego Ramos: Ack. Soft drains?
Ivy Park: Soft drains in 4-node cohorts, cohorts every 6m. Sequence: cordon -> drain -> kernel sanity -> nvlink check -> uncordon.
SRE-Nina: Recommend canary of 2 nodes with a 100-sample inference run and `nvidia-smi -q` checks. Abort on ECC >0 or nvlink CRC errors.
Priyanka: If we failover to us-west fallback, egress could spike. Can we cap cross-az failover to 12% and ramp over 90s?
SRE-Nina: Yes, set routing cap 12% + 90s ramp. Also pre-seed KV cache on 6 backfill nodes 20m prior.
Diego Ramos: Capacity sim now; threshold for two-region failover = queued >200.
Diego Ramos: Sim result: peak queued 148 units, projected GPU util 85% during cohort 3. No two-region failover needed.
Ivy Park: Cost estimate for fallback burst if used ~16 GPU-hours at $3.10/hr = ~$50. Finance tag infra-maint-az5-2026.
Priyanka: Ops checklist: tenant comms 24h + 1h, canary ready, oncall assigned, routing cap configured, backfill seeded.
SRE-Nina: Oncall please @ops-bot.
ops-bot: Scheduled oncall: Primary - SRE-Nina, Backup - Diego Ramos for 2026-03-30 00:15 UTC window.
Ivy Park: Draft tenant comms: 
```
Maintenance notice: Mon 00:15-01:30 UTC in az5. Impact: brief capacity reduction for az5-gpu-core. We will perform staggered soft drains and apply NIC microcode + kernel livepatch in 4-node cohorts. Some requests may be queued or routed to fallback. If you require reserved capacity, reply with tenant id. Expect short tail-latency increases during cohort validation.
```
Diego Ramos: Add link to runbook and oncall contact. Drain commands we'll run: 
```
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```
SRE-Nina: Validation greps: `journalctl -k | grep -i nvlink` and `dmesg | grep -E "MCE|PCIe|link error"`. Also `nvidia-smi -q | grep -i ecc`.
Ivy Park: I'll post the 24h comms and lock the runbook. Ping when 1h reminder is due. :thumbsup:
